::: {.lead}
This space brings together information about the plant species, the birds and the main points of interest surveyed on the estate. Use the **search box** (top left) to jump straight to a species by name, the **layers** panel to filter by type or turn on the three suggested **routes** (short, medium and long), and **select any point** to see its details.
:::

```{r}
source("scripts/cargar_datos.R")

library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

# Own SVG markers (pin + silhouette), embedded as data-URI so they always show.
marcador_svg <- function(archivo) {
  svg <- paste(readLines(file.path("fotos", archivo), warn = FALSE), collapse = "")
  uri <- paste0("data:image/svg+xml,", utils::URLencode(svg, reserved = TRUE))
  makeIcon(iconUrl = uri, iconWidth = 30, iconHeight = 42,
           iconAnchorX = 15, iconAnchorY = 42, popupAnchorX = 0, popupAnchorY = -38)
}

icono_arbol   <- marcador_svg("marcador_arbol.svg")
icono_conif   <- marcador_svg("marcador_conifera.svg")
icono_arbusto <- marcador_svg("marcador_arbusto.svg")
icono_palmera <- marcador_svg("marcador_palmera.svg")
icono_ave       <- marcador_svg("marcador_ave.svg")
icono_poi       <- marcador_svg("marcador_poi.svg")
icono_apadrinado <- marcador_svg("marcador_apadrinado.svg")

if (!"padrino" %in% names(arboles)) arboles$padrino <- NA

con_coord <- function(df) dplyr::filter(df, !is.na(latitud), !is.na(longitud))

# English labels for life-form (data values are in Spanish)
tr_forma <- c("Conífera"="Conifer", "Árbol latifoliado"="Broadleaf tree",
              "Arbusto"="Shrub", "Palmera"="Palm", "Otro"="Other")
forma_en <- function(x) { out <- unname(tr_forma[as.character(x)]); ifelse(is.na(out), as.character(x), out) }

# Translate Spanish geographic values into English (ordered phrase replacement).
# Vectorised: receives whole columns from the map popups (NA passes through).
region_en <- function(x) {
  s <- as.character(x)
  reps <- c("América del Norte"="North America","América del Sur"="South America",
            "América Central"="Central America","Norte América"="North America",
            "Sudamérica"="South America","Hemisferio Norte"="Northern Hemisphere",
            "Asia Occidental"="Western Asia","Sudeste Asiático"="Southeast Asia",
            "África del Norte"="North Africa","Islas Canarias"="Canary Islands",
            "Mediterráneo"="Mediterranean","Origen hortícola/Híbrido"="Horticultural/hybrid origin",
            "Origen hortícola/híbrido"="Horticultural/hybrid origin","Origen Híbrido"="Hybrid origin",
            "Cosmopolita tropical"="Pantropical","Cosmopolita"="Cosmopolitan",
            "Varias regiones"="Various regions","Sin dato"="No data","Balcanes"="Balkans",
            "Japón"="Japan","Taiwán"="Taiwan","México"="Mexico","E.E.U.U"="USA",
            "Oceanía"="Oceania","América"="Americas","Europa"="Europe","África"="Africa",
            "Central"="Central","Norte"="North")
  for (k in names(reps)) s <- gsub(k, reps[[k]], s, fixed = TRUE)
  s
}

# Rich popup for trees (empty fields are simply not shown)
popup_arbol <- function(df) {
  titulo <- ifelse(tiene_valor(df$nombre_comun), df$nombre_comun,
             ifelse(tiene_valor(df$nombre_cientifico), df$nombre_cientifico, df$ID))
  paste0(
    "<h3>", titulo, "</h3>",
    ifelse(tiene_valor(df$nombre_cientifico), paste0(sci_html(df$nombre_cientifico, df$autor), "<br><br>"), "<br>"),
    ifelse(tiene_valor(df$foto), paste0("<img src='../fotos/", df$foto,
           "' style='max-width:120px; height:auto; border-radius:8px;'><br><br>"), ""),
    ifelse(tiene_valor(df$familia),    paste0("<b>Family:</b> ", df$familia, "<br>"), ""),
    ifelse(tiene_valor(df$forma_vida), paste0("<b>Type:</b> ", forma_en(df$forma_vida), "<br>"), ""),
    ifelse(tiene_valor(df$continente),paste0("<b>Origin:</b> ", region_en(df$continente), "<br>"), ""),
    ifelse(nzchar(df$iucn), paste0("<b>Conservation (IUCN):</b> ", iucn_badge(df$iucn, "en"), "<br>"), ""),
    ifelse(tiene_valor(df$año_plantacion), paste0("<b>Planted:</b> ", df$año_plantacion, "<br>"), ""),
    ifelse(tiene_valor(df$padrino), paste0("<b>Sponsored by:</b> ", df$padrino, "<br>"), ""),
    ifelse(tiene_valor(df$slug), paste0("<div style='margin-top:.55rem;'><a href='fichas/", df$slug, ".html'><b>See full profile →</b></a></div>"), ""),
    "<div style='margin-top:.35rem;font-size:.8rem;'><a href='sponsor.html'><i class='bi bi-tree'></i> Sponsor a specimen like this →</a></div>"
  )
}

# Sponsored trees: shown separately, with their own marker.
apad <- con_coord(dplyr::filter(arboles, tiene_valor(padrino)))

base_np <- dplyr::filter(arboles, !tiene_valor(padrino))
fv <- function(patron) con_coord(dplyr::filter(base_np,
        tiene_valor(forma_vida), grepl(patron, forma_vida, ignore.case = TRUE)))
coni <- fv("con[ií]fera")
lati <- fv("latifoliad")
arbu <- fv("arbusto")
palm <- fv("palmera")
otro <- con_coord(dplyr::filter(base_np,
          !tiene_valor(forma_vida) |
          !grepl("con[ií]fera|latifoliad|arbusto|palmera", forma_vida, ignore.case = TRUE)))
avs  <- con_coord(aves)
pts  <- con_coord(puntos)
```

```{r}
m <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Map (streets)") %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") %>%

  addMarkers(
    data = coni, lng = ~longitud, lat = ~latitud,
    icon = icono_conif, group = "Conifers",
    popup = popup_arbol(coni)
  ) %>%

  addMarkers(
    data = lati, lng = ~longitud, lat = ~latitud,
    icon = icono_arbol, group = "Broadleaf trees",
    popup = popup_arbol(lati)
  ) %>%

  addMarkers(
    data = arbu, lng = ~longitud, lat = ~latitud,
    icon = icono_arbusto, group = "Shrubs",
    popup = popup_arbol(arbu)
  ) %>%

  addMarkers(
    data = palm, lng = ~longitud, lat = ~latitud,
    icon = icono_palmera, group = "Palms",
    popup = popup_arbol(palm)
  ) %>%

  addMarkers(
    data = apad, lng = ~longitud, lat = ~latitud,
    icon = icono_apadrinado, group = "Sponsored trees",
    popup = popup_arbol(apad)
  ) %>%

  addMarkers(
    data = otro, lng = ~longitud, lat = ~latitud,
    icon = icono_arbol, group = "Other species",
    popup = popup_arbol(otro)
  ) %>%

  addMarkers(
    data = avs, lng = ~longitud, lat = ~latitud,
    icon = icono_ave, group = "Birds",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<h3>", ifelse(tiene_valor(especie), especie, "Bird"), "</h3>",
      ifelse(tiene_valor(nombre_cientifico), paste0(sci_html(nombre_cientifico), "<br><br>"), "<br>"),
      ifelse(tiene_valor(foto), paste0("<img src='../fotos/", foto,
             "' style='max-width:120px; height:auto; border-radius:8px;'><br><br>"), ""),
      ifelse(tiene_valor(observacion), paste0("<b>Season observed:</b> ", observacion), "")
    )
  ) %>%

  addMarkers(
    data = pts, lng = ~longitud, lat = ~latitud,
    icon = icono_poi, group = "Points of interest",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<h3>", ifelse(tiene_valor(nombre), nombre, "Point of interest"), "</h3>",
      ifelse(tiene_valor(descripcion), paste0("<i>", descripcion, "</i><br><br>"), ""),
      ifelse(tiene_valor(foto), paste0("<img src='../fotos/", foto,
             "' style='max-width:120px; height:auto; border-radius:8px;'><br><br>"), "")
    )
  )

# --- GIS layers: auto-loaded if the file exists in gis/ ---
capas_gis <- list(
  list(archivo = "gis/senderos.geojson",         grupo = "Trails", color = "#B8860B", relleno = FALSE, peso = 2),
  list(archivo = "gis/sectores.geojson",         grupo = "Sectors", color = "#1E4A38", relleno = TRUE,  peso = 2),
  list(archivo = "gis/lagunas.geojson",          grupo = "Ponds",  color = "#1f78b4", relleno = TRUE,  peso = 2),
  list(archivo = "gis/recorrido_largo.geojson",  grupo = "Long route", color = "#7A3CC8", relleno = FALSE, peso = 4),
  list(archivo = "gis/recorrido_medio.geojson",  grupo = "Medium route", color = "#D22828", relleno = FALSE, peso = 4),
  list(archivo = "gis/recorrido_corto.geojson",  grupo = "Short route", color = "#FFD400", relleno = FALSE, peso = 4)
)

grupos_gis <- character(0)
for (capa in capas_gis) {
  if (file.exists(capa$archivo)) {
    gj <- paste(readLines(capa$archivo, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
    m <- m %>% addGeoJSON(
      gj, group = capa$grupo,
      color = capa$color, weight = capa$peso, opacity = 0.95,
      fill = capa$relleno, fillColor = capa$color, fillOpacity = 0.2
    )
    grupos_gis <- c(grupos_gis, capa$grupo)
  }
}

# --- Illustrated sector layer (tree icons, plan style) ------------
grupo_sectores <- character(0)
if (file.exists("gis/iconos_sectores.geojson")) {
  grupo_sectores <- tryCatch({
    ic <- jsonlite::fromJSON("gis/iconos_sectores.geojson", simplifyVector = TRUE)
    fr <- ic$features
    coords <- do.call(rbind, fr$geometry$coordinates)
    sec_df <- data.frame(
      lng = as.numeric(coords[, 1]), lat = as.numeric(coords[, 2]),
      icono = as.character(fr$properties$icono),
      sector = as.character(fr$properties$sector),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    uri_por_icono <- vapply(unique(sec_df$icono), function(a) {
      svg <- paste(readLines(file.path("fotos", paste0(a, ".svg")), warn = FALSE), collapse = "")
      paste0("data:image/svg+xml,", utils::URLencode(svg, reserved = TRUE))
    }, character(1))
    sec_icons <- icons(
      iconUrl = unname(uri_por_icono[sec_df$icono]),
      iconWidth = 22, iconHeight = 26, iconAnchorX = 11, iconAnchorY = 25
    )
    m <<- m %>% addMarkers(
      data = sec_df, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
      icon = sec_icons, group = "Sectors (illustrated)",
      options = markerOptions(interactive = FALSE, keyboard = FALSE, zIndexOffset = -1000)
    )
    "Sectors (illustrated)"
  }, error = function(e) { message("map.qmd: sector layer omitted (", conditionMessage(e), ")"); character(0) })
}

m <- m %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Satellite", "Map (streets)"),
    overlayGroups = c("Conifers", "Broadleaf trees", "Shrubs", "Palms",
                      "Sponsored trees", "Other species", "Birds", "Points of interest",
                      grupos_gis, grupo_sectores),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

# Suggested routes: hidden by default, activated from the layers panel
m <- m %>% hideGroup(c("Long route", "Medium route", "Short route"))

# --- Visual legend (uses the same markers as the map) -------------------
leyenda_items <- c(
  "marcador_conifera.svg"   = "Conifer",
  "marcador_arbol.svg"      = "Broadleaf",
  "marcador_arbusto.svg"    = "Shrub",
  "marcador_palmera.svg"    = "Palm",
  "marcador_apadrinado.svg" = "Sponsored",
  "marcador_ave.svg"        = "Bird",
  "marcador_poi.svg"        = "Point of interest"
)
leyenda_html <- paste0(
  "<div style='background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);padding:4px 9px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.2);font-size:.72rem;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1px 10px;align-items:center;max-width:92vw;'>",
  paste0("<span style='display:inline-flex;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap;'>",
         "<img src='../fotos/", names(leyenda_items),
         "' style='height:15px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:3px;'>", leyenda_items, "</span>",
         collapse = ""),
  "</div>"
)
m <- m %>% addControl(html = leyenda_html, position = "bottomright")

# --- Sector-layer legend (tree icons) ----------------------
if (length(grupo_sectores) > 0) {
  sec_leg <- c(
    "sector_pinar.svg"       = "Pine grove",
    "sector_eucaliptos.svg"  = "Eucalyptus wood",
    "sector_cipres.svg"      = "Cypress screens",
    "sector_robledal.svg"    = "Oak grove",
    "sector_cedros.svg"      = "Cedars",
    "sector_sauces.svg"      = "Willows & lowland"
  )
  sec_leg_html <- paste0(
    "<div style='background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);padding:5px 9px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.2);font-size:.72rem;max-width:92vw;'>",
    "<b style='display:block;margin-bottom:2px;color:#1E4A38;'>Sectors</b>",
    "<div style='display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1px 10px;align-items:center;'>",
    paste0("<span style='display:inline-flex;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap;'>",
           "<img src='../fotos/", names(sec_leg),
           "' style='height:18px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:3px;'>", sec_leg, "</span>",
           collapse = ""),
    "</div></div>"
  )
  m <- m %>% addControl(html = sec_leg_html, position = "bottomright")
}

# --- Auto-fit to all surveyed points ----------------------
.bb <- rbind(
  con_coord(arboles)[, c("longitud", "latitud")],
  avs[, c("longitud", "latitud")],
  pts[, c("longitud", "latitud")]
)
if (nrow(.bb) > 0) {
  m <- m %>% fitBounds(min(.bb$longitud), min(.bb$latitud),
                       max(.bb$longitud), max(.bb$latitud))
}

# --- On-map search (pure JavaScript; no external packages) --------
m <- tryCatch({
  ab  <- con_coord(arboles)
  av2 <- con_coord(aves)
  b1 <- data.frame(
    nombre = ifelse(tiene_valor(ab$nombre_comun), as.character(ab$nombre_comun),
             ifelse(tiene_valor(ab$nombre_cientifico), as.character(ab$nombre_cientifico), as.character(ab$ID))),
    cientifico = ifelse(tiene_valor(ab$nombre_cientifico), as.character(ab$nombre_cientifico), ""),
    lat = as.numeric(ab$latitud), lng = as.numeric(ab$longitud),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  b2 <- data.frame(
    nombre = ifelse(tiene_valor(av2$especie), as.character(av2$especie),
             ifelse(tiene_valor(av2$nombre_cientifico), as.character(av2$nombre_cientifico), "Bird")),
    cientifico = ifelse(tiene_valor(av2$nombre_cientifico), as.character(av2$nombre_cientifico), ""),
    lat = as.numeric(av2$latitud), lng = as.numeric(av2$longitud),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  buscables <- rbind(b1, b2)
  buscables <- buscables[!is.na(buscables$lat) & !is.na(buscables$lng) & buscables$nombre != "", ]
  datos_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(buscables, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)

  js <- paste0(
"function(el, x) {
  var map = this;
  var pts = ", datos_json, ";
  setTimeout(function(){ map.invalidateSize(); }, 200);
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ map.invalidateSize(); });
  function norm(s){ return (s==null?'':String(s)).toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g,''); }
  var Ctrl = L.Control.extend({
    options: { position: 'topleft' },
    onAdd: function(){
      var box = L.DomUtil.create('div','arb-buscador');
      var input = L.DomUtil.create('input','arb-input', box);
      input.type = 'text';
      input.placeholder = 'Search species...';
      input.setAttribute('aria-label','Search species');
      var out = L.DomUtil.create('div','arb-resultados', box);
      out.style.display = 'none';
      L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(box);
      L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(box);
      function cerrar(){ out.style.display='none'; while(out.firstChild) out.removeChild(out.firstChild); }
      function ir(p){
        map.setView([p.lat, p.lng], 19);
        var html = '<b>'+(p.nombre||'')+'</b>' + (p.cientifico ? '<br><i>'+p.cientifico+'</i>' : '');
        L.popup().setLatLng([p.lat, p.lng]).setContent(html).openOn(map);
        input.value = p.nombre; cerrar();
      }
      function buscar(){
        var q = norm(input.value); cerrar();
        if(q.length < 2) return;
        var n = 0;
        for(var i=0; i<pts.length && n<8; i++){
          var p = pts[i];
          if(norm(p.nombre).indexOf(q)>=0 || norm(p.cientifico).indexOf(q)>=0){
            var it = L.DomUtil.create('div','arb-item', out);
            var s = L.DomUtil.create('span','', it); s.textContent = p.nombre;
            if(p.cientifico){ var em = L.DomUtil.create('em','', it); em.textContent = ' '+p.cientifico; }
            (function(pp){ it.addEventListener('click', function(){ ir(pp); }); })(p);
            n++;
          }
        }
        out.style.display = n ? 'block' : 'none';
      }
      L.DomEvent.on(input,'input',buscar);
      L.DomEvent.on(input,'focus',buscar);
      L.DomEvent.on(input,'keydown',function(e){
        if(e.keyCode===13){ var f=out.querySelector('.arb-item'); if(f) f.click(); }
        else if(e.keyCode===27){ cerrar(); }
      });
      return box;
    }
  });
  map.addControl(new Ctrl());

  // --- 'My location' button (browser native geolocation) ---
  var LocateCtrl = L.Control.extend({
    options: { position: 'topleft' },
    onAdd: function(){
      var b = L.DomUtil.create('div','leaflet-bar arb-locate');
      var a = L.DomUtil.create('a','', b);
      a.href = '#'; a.title = 'Show my location';
      a.innerHTML = '<i class=\"bi bi-geo-alt-fill\"></i>';
      a.style.cssText = 'font-size:15px;line-height:26px;text-align:center;color:#1E4A38;';
      L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(b);
      L.DomEvent.on(a,'click',function(e){
        L.DomEvent.stop(e);
        if(!navigator.geolocation){ return; }
        a.innerHTML = '…';
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function(pos){
          a.innerHTML = '<i class=\"bi bi-geo-alt-fill\"></i>';
          var ll = [pos.coords.latitude, pos.coords.longitude];
          map.setView(ll, 18);
          L.circleMarker(ll, {radius:9, color:'#1E4A38', fillColor:'#2f6b4f', fillOpacity:.9, weight:2})
            .addTo(map).bindPopup('You are here').openPopup();
        }, function(){ a.innerHTML = '<i class=\"bi bi-geo-alt-fill\"></i>'; });
      });
      return b;
    }
  });
  map.addControl(new LocateCtrl());
}")
  htmlwidgets::onRender(m, js)
}, error = function(e) { message('map.qmd: search omitted (', conditionMessage(e), ')'); m })

m
```
